_comment: Answers for deploy/clone-tenant.sh / tools/generate-tenant-config.mjs. This exact file produced config/tenants/northline-metal.json, the second tenant the isolation model was proven against. Copy it, change every value, and keep TENANT_ID, SENDER_DOMAIN and SENDER_MAILBOX unique across config/tenants/. Anything not listed here takes the template's invariant or the province default; a province other than AB must also state TIMEZONE, GST_RATE_BPS, PST_RATE_BPS, PRIVACY_LAW and PREPAID_LICENCE_ID_ENV.
